name: ibis Styles Manila Araneta City
short_description: A budget-friendly hotel dual-branded with Novotel Manila in the Araneta City complex, with Le Bistro restaurant and The Edge Skyview Bar.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Manila Araneta City sits on General Roxas Avenue within the Araneta City complex in Quezon City, sharing the site with Novotel Manila Araneta City for guests wanting a more budget-friendly Accor option in the same mall-connected location. Dining includes Le Bistro restaurant and The Edge Skyview Bar, and the hotel is rated highly on Booking.com for value. Guests consistently praise the central Araneta City location and value for money, making it a popular pick for travelers prioritizing budget and mall access over full-service amenities.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Manila Araneta City connected to Novotel Manila?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the two hotels are dual-branded within the same Araneta City complex, giving budget-conscious travelers a more affordable Accor option alongside the full-service Novotel in the same mall-connected location.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Manila Araneta City good value?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's rated 8.9/10 on Booking.com across more than 1,200 reviews, with guests consistently citing strong value for money given the central, mall-connected Araneta City location.
